about_the_game:
If you could use magic and lived in the late 16th century, how would you choose to live?

If you cherished solitude but one day impulsively made a friend, would you try to protect her from charges of "heresy"?

In this mountain village, you can help the villagers with their requests—or choose not to.

Every decision you make can come from your heart or mere whimsy. Your choices will shape your life and the life of your closest friend.

Play as a wise woman living in the 16th century. To complete your graduation project, you settle temporarily in a remote mountain village.

Help your neighbors with their daily struggles, and they will help you in return.

Fight alongside your best friend to confront beasts and other creatures threatening the village. Uncover the secrets of magic through your journey, and perhaps even face your inner demons.

Read and make choices to steer the story, experiencing up to four text-based battles and six possible endings—along with local culinary specialties.

The game contains approximately 120,000 words of text, featuring up to four text-based battles, six possible endings, and local delicacies.

No matter how tough life gets, don’t forget to enjoy a good meal.

Art assets created with AI assistance. Sources:
MiaoMiao Pixel (by Orscat)
Illustrious Flanime XL - High-Quality Flat Anime (by Orscat)

content_descriptors.notes:
包含杀害家畜，狩猎野生动物，破坏野生动物尸体的行为。
包含用魔法，弓箭，近战武器杀死人类敌人的行为。
包含与敌人肉搏的场景。
